# Meets

> A vibeslopped, meetings-focused fork of Muesli for macOS.

Meets is a native Swift, SwiftUI, and AppKit app maintained by GantisStorm. It records microphone and system audio, transcribes locally, organizes meeting notes, and provides calendar integration, Insights, exports, and a bundled CLI.

## Privacy and providers

Speech-to-text runs locally. Optional hosted summaries and cleanup send text and included context to the configured provider. Providers include ChatGPT, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, custom endpoints, ACP agents, and on-device Apple Intelligence. This fork's Apple Intelligence adapter requires macOS 27+ and a ready system model. Local cleanup models are also supported.

Optional iCloud support syncs text and metadata, not audio, and requires a provisioned CloudKit build. Build scripts configure TelemetryDeck routing; unconfigured direct builds disable telemetry. See the README for the complete privacy and deployment limitations.

## Availability

- Source repository and build instructions: https://github.com/GantisStorm/meets
- Releases: https://github.com/GantisStorm/meets/releases (no binary releases published yet)
- Runtime: Apple Silicon, macOS 14.2+; some features require newer macOS.
- Build: full Xcode 26.6 / Swift 6.3, xcodegen, CMake, complete LocalVQE runtime.
- License: MIT, with separate dependency and model licenses.
- Upstream: https://github.com/Muesli-HQ/muesli, originally by Pranav Hari and contributors.

The fork retains the upstream git history and copyright notice. It is not an official Muesli release. There is no official Meets Homebrew cask or companion iPhone release from this repository.
